label: Передать настоящий ZCode receipt через готовый AHAP runner
description: Current ZCode runner returns admitted/inputId/pending without nativeInputMessageId; общий core правильно сохраняет UNKNOWN. Reuse working CI L45 native protocol/receipt, явно передать подтверждённый native identity и readback correlation без synthetic caller-ID и без retry. Допускается источник результата native adapter, никакие live UNKNOWN не повторять.
acceptance: Реальные documented/recorded native response shapes → exact receipt mapping; pending без native confirmation остаётся pending/UNKNOWN. Source contract tests positive/ambiguous/no replay+published scoped delta; новый native case только отдельно после ready artifact.

changes.result: Source published to origin/main as dc9d882103002b09e4109019a7a880f3fda3cf54 (parent 303cba8d2c522ac3b3fadd971326ee2e295a280b). Scoped paths only: src/adapters/zcode.ts, src/ahap-zcode-runner.ts, tests/ahap-zcode-runner.test.ts, acceptance/native/zcode/ahap-contract.json. Reused zcodeNativeAdmission read-only exact same-session message lookup requiring adapter-derived sourceCommandId; nativeInputMessageId is copied only from the matching native user row, with turnId separate. Caller inputId is unchanged. Missing anchor/turn-only evidence does not synthesize nativeInputMessageId; UNKNOWN/pending semantics remain. Evidence: npx vitest run --root . --config vitest.config.ts tests/ahap-zcode-runner.test.ts: 7/7 passed; npx tsc --noEmit passed; git diff --check passed. Tests cover exact receipt, turnId-only, other-session/wrong-command mismatch, and existing ambiguous no-retry. No native sends; V078 remains separate; V072D/V072E UNKNOWN not replayed. Exact signature hunk: ZcodeAdapter.sendMessage queue/steer/images branch normalizes admission, derives native correlation with zcodeInputId(callerInputId, origin), calls zcodeNativeAdmission(localDbPath, id, [nativeCommandId]), and copies only native.userMessageId to nativeInputMessageId plus native.turnId separately. Remote main readback: dc9d882103002b09e4109019a7a880f3fda3cf54.
